notes: Trimmed pual's "be weighed; be valued" to "be valued" per the compound-gloss trim audit: Job.28.16/28.19 ("cannot be valued with the gold of Ophir") show the figurative "be valued" sense; "be weighed" is the root's literal etymological sense (BDB: "to hang up, i.e. weigh") but no citation shows an actual weighing.
Trimmed "make light of; reject" to "reject" per the tightened compound-gloss standard: both describe the one Ps.119.118 citation ("trodden down") -- synonyms, not two senses.
Trimmed piel's "flout; reject" to "reject" per the tightened compound-gloss standard: both describe the one Lam.1.15 citation ("trodden under foot") -- synonyms, not two senses.
